dict.string: Connect to your ENGO 3 smart glasses.
Connect to the free local AI model running on your Mac while you are on a trusted Wi-Fi network.
Take photos to recognize printed text locally on your iPhone and display it through ENGO 3.
Use the iPhone microphone only when you start captions or speech input.
Transcribe speech when you choose live captions.
With your permission, display your upcoming iPhone calendar events on your ENGO 3 glasses. OpenLens never changes events.
Show your calendar's upcoming events on your ENGO 3 after you connect it.
With your permission, read incomplete iPhone reminders to display them on your ENGO 3. OpenLens does not modify tasks.
Show your existing incomplete iPhone reminders on your ENGO 3 glasses.
Select a contact to display its name and chosen details on ENGO 3 without importing your entire address book.
Find walking routes from your current position when requested.
